name: Connect an account
description: Starts connecting the caller's account at an OAuth provider (google, microsoft, github, or any provider the operator configured). Returns the URL the user must open and approve; the provider then calls the venue back and the grant is stored for the caller. Nothing is connected until the user approves. Afterwards, call the provider's API with http:get / http:post and bearerSecret "oauth/<provider>" — the access token never appears in your context.

provider.description: A configured provider name — see v/info/adapters/oauth

scopes.description: Scopes to request; the provider's configured defaults when omitted

returnTo.description: Where the browser goes after approval: a venue-relative path, or a URL under an operator-allowed prefix (adapters.oauth.returnTo)

url.description: The authorisation URL for the user to open — hand it to the user (a hitl ask is the natural way), never open it yourself

state.description: The one-time request identifier bound to this caller

expiresAt.description: Epoch millis after which the request lapses and must be started again
